description: Make an AI Fruit Story video (3D cartoon fruit people in a short soap opera). It spends credits from the user's MakeViral account (a scene that fails gives its credits back) and takes several minutes: this call returns at once, then call get_fruit_story with wait true. Send the cast (1-3 fruit people) and either your own story as `draft` (written with fruit_story_guide's prompts) or only an idea, and MakeViral writes it. Before calling, tell the user the price in credits (fruit_story_guide). Calling again with the same input within 10 minutes returns the first story.

fruit.description: A typed fruit, e.g. mango (without presetId)

presetId.description: A ready-made fruit person id (fruit_story_guide), or leave it out and type a fruit

draft.description: Your own story: the JSON the writer prompt of fruit_story_guide asks for (title, looks, numbers, scenes).

idea.description: One line, or a few 'Name: line' lines the story must use

requestId.description: Optional id (8-64 letters, digits, - or _). The same id never charges twice.

sceneCount.description: Scenes of about 8 s each. Default 6.

name: start_fruit_story
title: Make a fruit story
